the parlour floor's ledge at y 172 px against the cut's 150: the cut draws every height tall (its pixel aspect 0.743) and its basement storey about 0.7 m taller again; the early-1890s photograph's landing stands about a man's height over the stoop's foot, as the record's 2.2 m does

the basement lights: the cut draws two tall barred lights, about 1.6 m high on its scale; K02 tops its two base courses at the area lights' heads and lays no course over 0.41 m, so they are built 0.8 m high and without bars (L-k01-2108-kimball-3667). A street visitor sees the shorter lights, so this stays open until K02 can lay a taller base or K01 a grille in an area light
the upper storey and the wall head: under the cut's numerals (three dark lights show over its three bays, as the build has them)
